Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players of Pakistan have made their way out in the middle. Shai Hope and Brandon King are at the crease. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball.
We are back!
...THE RUN CHASE...

Right then. Pakistan have a huge total on the board and then will fancy themselves to chase this down. But the pitch is good and if Windies batters get off to a good start then they have a chance to chase this down. Can they chase down this huge total?  We shall find out soon.

When you play Pakistan there is one wicket that you always want to get early and Akeal Hosein did exactly that as he picked Babar Azam for a duck in the very first over. They got another wicket in the Powerplay and made sure that they keep the run rate in check. But things started going out of control after the halfway mark as runs started leaking from both ends. But just when Pakistan were running away with the game, Romario Shepherd  broke the partnership with a wicket of Rizwan and that brought a couple of wickets more in the next few overs. But few lusty blows in the end have made sure that West Indies have to chase a huge total here.

The Pakistan opening partnership has been giving them good starts right from the time Rizwan and Babar started opening. But not today as their prolific captain, departed for a duck. Fakhar Zaman also failed to make an impression and departed soon. But the real carnage started after the halfway mark as both Rizwan and Haider Ali went berserk as they smashed 65 runs in the next five overs. Rizwan departed in the very next over after that and dangerous Asif Ali also could not last long. But Haider Ali continued in his merry way and Nawaz with his fireworks in the end ensured that Pakistan finish on a high.

So Pakistan finish with 200 on the board. A very good total and thanks to some fantastic hitting after the halfway mark by Haider Ali and Mohammad Rizwan. In the end, it was Mohammad Nawaz has played a superb cameo and that has powered them to 200. Pakistan bowlers will fancy themselves to defend this but expect West Indies to fight hard with all their firepower. An interesting chase coning up.
Banged in short, around leg. Mohammad Nawaz swivels and pulls it to fine leg for a run. Pakistan end with 200/6.
SIX! That is a serious shot! Drakes looks for a yorker, outside off but ends up bowling a half-volley. Nawaz gets low and pumps it over long off to collect a biggie.
Length ball, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz chips it over the extra cover fielder and collects a couple of runs.
Shadab Khan is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! End of a very fine innings from Haider Ali. This was a full ball, around off. Ali gets under it and looks to go downtown but he gets the toe end of his bat and the ball goes high into the night sky and straight to Odean Smith at long on who takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Dominic Drakes

Commentary.Commentary: A slower bumper, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Full ball, outside off. Haider Ali reaches out and drags it to sweeper cover for a single.
Dominic Drakes to bowl the last over.
SIX! BOOM! Back of a length, just outside off. Mohammad Nawaz hangs back and smokes it over the long off region to bag a maximum! Big over for Pakistan as 20 runs came off it.
FOUR! Top shot! Full ball, way outside off. Nawaz gets low and slices it past the deep cover fielder to collect a boundary.
Wide! Too wide, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz lets it be. Wided!

DROPPED! FOUR! Full ball, way outside off. Nawaz looks to squeeze it out but he gets a thick outside edge. Odean Smith at the gully region hops to take the catch but he just manages to get a hand on it and the ball races away to the third man fence.
Good change of pace from Shepherd! A slower ball, into the surface, around middle. Haider Ali looks to pull but he misses and gets hit on his body. The ball rolls away to the leg side for a leg bye.
Fuller in length, yet again outside off. Mohammad Nawaz looks to go over cover but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards deep point for a run.
FOUR! Full ball, outside off. Nawaz squeezes it past the short third man fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
Romario Shepherd is back into the attack.
SIX! WOW! What a clean strike to end the over! Fuller in length, outside off. Haider Ali smacks it over the extra cover region and bags a maximum!
On a length, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz looks to drive on the up but he gets an outside edge towards third man for one.
Mohammad Nawaz is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! This time Hope pouches it and Iftikhar Ahmed has to walk to back to the hut! Back of a length, way outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed looks to guide it past the short third man fielder but he gets a thick outside edge which goes to the right of the keeper. Shai Hope moves across to his right and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Shai Hope drops a regulation catch behind the sticks. Good-length ball, outside off. Haider Ali looks to heave it away but he gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes towards Hope who drops a sitter. The batters take a run.
Banged in short, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed looks to pull but he gets an under-edge and the ball goes to the cover region for a run.
FOUR! Flicked away! Full ball, darted on the pads. Ahmed whips it off his pads behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Odean Smith is back into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely done! Short of a length, outside off. Haider Ali hangs back and guides it past the short third man fielder for a boundary.

A slower ball, into the pitch, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed stays back and flat-bats it straight to Nicholas Pooran at mid off and takes off for a run. Pooran takes the catch and has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses.
NO BALL! A yorker-length delivery, around off. Haider Ali works it to long on for a single. Free Hit coming up as Oshane Thomas oversteps.
Full ball, darted on the pads. Iftikhar Ahmed clips it to fine leg and gets off the mark with a run.
Iftikhar Ahmed is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Oshane Thomas gets the wicket of the dangerous Asif Ali! Thomas hurls a slower ball, into the deck, outside off. Asif Ali looks to pull hard but he mistimes it and hits it straight to Rovman Powell att deep mid-wicket who takes a simple catch. Pakistan lose their fourth wicket now!
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Oshane Thomas

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, outside off. Haider Ali drills it to long off for a single.
A full toss, on middle. Haider Ali pushes it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Oshane Thomas is back into the attack.
Another play and a miss! A slower ball, shorter in length, way outside off. Asif Ali looks to heave it away but the ball goes past his blade. Just 4 runs and a wicket off the over!
A slower ball, into the pitch, outside off. Asif Ali looks to pull but he misses.
A low full toss, outside off. Haider Ali squeezes it out to deep cover for a run.
Wide! Fuller in length, outside off and just outside the tramline. Haider Ali lets it be. Wide called by the umpire.
Back of a length, outside off. Asif Ali hangs back and steers it to third man for a single. He gets off the mark straightaway!
A full toss, outside off. Haider Ali looks to slog but he gets an under-edge and the ball goes to short third man fielder. The batters cross for a run.
Asif Ali is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammad Rizwan departs and this is a huge wicket for West Indies. A slower ball, fuller in length, around off. Rizwan looks to tonk it over the mid-wicket region but he miscues it and the ball goes high in the air to wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder. Odean Smith there runs to his right and takes a good running catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Romario Shepherd comes back to bowl.

SIX! This is huge and what a way to get to his fifty! A length ball, on off. Haider Ali gets under it as he stays deep in his crease and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That has gone a long way and Haider Ali gets to his fifty in just 28 balls.
A full ball, around off this time. Haider Ali looks to hit it straight but misses.
FOUR! Another lucky boundary for Haider Ali and Odean Smith continues to be unlucky! A length ball, on middle. Haider Ali looks to pull but gets an inside edge past short fine leg for a boundary.
A length ball, on middle. Rizwan sweeps it to deep mid-wicket this time for a single.
Shorter length, on off. Haider Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Rizwan pushes this off the back foot to backward point for a single.
Odean Smith (2-0-30-0) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! A slower full ball, outside off. Haider Ali just slices it over the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller ball again, on middle. Rizwan works it to square leg for a single.
A full ball, on middle. Haider Ali drills it to long on for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Ali looks to hit it away but misses.
SIX! What a shot! A short ball and outside off. Haider Ali backs away and cuts it over point for a maximum.
A full ball, on off. Rizwan drives it to long on for a single.
Dominic Drakes (2-0-19-0) is back on.
BEATEN! A good-length delivery around off. Haider Ali looks to push at it from his crease but the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
A full ball, on leg. Flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Ali looks to push it off the back foot towards the off side but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Worked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Rizwan looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
Short ball, on off again. Rizwan just waits for it and ramps it over the keeper's head for a couple.
FOUR! Short ball, on off. Rizwan pulls this off the front foot towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
NO BALL! A full toss above the waist, down the leg side. Rizwan looks to pull but misses. No ball called for height and Free Hit coming up.
Oshane Thomas (2-0-17-0) is back on.
FOUR! This time he gets cute! A length ball, on off. Haider Ali uses the pace of the ball and guides it wide of short third man for another boundary. Huge over for Pakistan.
SIX! Short ball and punished! A short ball, on off. Haider Ali rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A length ball, on middle. Worked away to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Another lucky boundary! Back of a length, on middle. Rizwan looks to work it away but gets a thick outside edge which flies over the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Shorter in length, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A brilliant yorker but it goes off for a boundary! A yorker on middle and leg. Haider Ali looks to jam it out but gets an inside edge wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Odean Smith (1-0-10-0) comes back to bowl.
Shorter in length, around off. Haider Ali cuts it to sweeper cover and gets a single.
Flatter on middle. Rizwan skips down the track and pushes it to wide of long on for a single.

FOUR! Little lucky there for Mohammad Rizwan! Mohammad Rizwan skips down the track and Akeal Hosein adjusts his length a little and bowls it shorter, outside off. Rizwan goes through his inside out shot and gets a thick outside edge over short third man for a boundary.
Fuller on off. Ali sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter on off. Rizwan pushes it off the front foot towards the off side and gets a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Rizwan plays it back to the bowler.

Drinks! Pakistan have done well after losing their skipper for a duck. Mohammad Rizwan continues to impress and Haider Ali has a great chance here to show his worth with the bat. West Indies will look to chip in with wickets and make sure that Pakistan do not run away with the score.
Back of a length, on middle. Rizwan tucks it to deep mid-wicket and collects a run.
FOUR! Top shot! Short of a length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan stays back, opens the face of his bat and steers it past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Brilliant running! Good-length ball, on leg. Rizwan nudges it to the on side and comes back for the second run. He brings up his fifty off just 34 balls.
Fuller in length, around middle and leg. Mohammad Rizwan clips it behind square on the leg side and takes a couple of runs.
FOUR! Punished by Mohammad Rizwan! A juicy full toss, outside off, asking to be hit. Rizwan whips it to wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder to collect a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan stays back and punches it to the extra cover fielder.
Romario Shepherd is back into the attack
Floated, on a length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan defends it to wide of cover and takes off for a run. Another good over from Akeal Hosein as just 5 runs came off it.
Good running! On a length, around middle. Rizwan tucks it to the vacant mid on region and scampers back for the second run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan rocks back and slices it to backward point.
A slight mix-up but no harm done! Fuller in length, on off. Mohammad Rizwan taps it to cover and looks for a run but Ali sends him back.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Ali stays back and cuts hard. Shamarh Brooks at backward point dives to his right and stops the ball. The batters cross for a single.
A quicker ball, on a length, outside off. Rizwan rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! BANG! Banged in short, yet again outside off. Ali stays back and pulls it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder. The fielder there puts in a dive but the ball sneaks through and races away to the fence.
Play and a miss! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Haider Ali looks to hoick it to the leg side but he misses.
Excellent delivery! A yorker, around off. Haider Ali digs it out back to the bowler.
Another ball, shorter in length, outside off. Rizwan swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! WHACKED! Banged in short, outside off. Rizwan pulls it in front of square and collects a boundary. Pakistan bring up their 50!
Back of a length, just outside off. Haider Ali hangs back, opens the face of his bat and steers it towards third man for a single.
Odean Smith is into the attack now.
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Haider Ali tucks it to the leg side and keeps the strike for the next over by taking a run. Just 3 runs off the over!
Fuller in length, outside off. Rizwan works it to wide of long off and rotates the strike.
BEATEN! Top delivery from Hosein! Flatter ball, around off and spinning away late. Rizwan prods to block this one but the ball spins past his outside edge.
Slightly shorter in length, around middle. Haider Ali sits back and eases it to long on for one.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, outside off. Ali hangs back and cuts but finds the backward point fielder.
Flatter ball, outside off. Haider Ali cuts it to cover-point and looks for a run but is sent back by Rizwan.
Akeal Hosein is back into the attack.
Good-length ball, darted on the pads. Ali hangs back and works it to deep square leg for a run. At the end of the Powerplay, the hosts are 44/2.
On a length, around the fifth stump channel. Haider Ali prods and pushes it to cover.
Fuller in length, around middle. Rizwan clips it to wide of mid on for a brace.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! An off-pace delivery, shorter in length, outside off. Rizwan stays back and cuts it past the cover fielder to collect a boundary.
Length ball, way outside off. Haider Ali presses forward and caresses it to deep cover. Ali is off the mark with a single.
Back of a length, around off. Mohammad Rizwan taps it to backward point and takes a run.
Dominic Drakes comes back to bowl.
Fuller on off. Mohammad Rizwan pushes it to mid on and gets a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Rizwan is safe.
Haider Ali is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fakhar Zaman looks to go big downtown but holes out! An off-pace delivery fuller on middle. Fakhar Zaman gets under it and looks to smash it over long on. He gets the elevation but fails to gets the distance. The ball goes high in the air towards long on and Shamarh Brooks there takes a fine catch. Fakhar Zaman has to walk back and Pakistan lose their second now.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on middle. Rizwan works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Zaman pushes it off the back foot to point and a quick single is taken yet again.
Back of a length, on off. Rizwan works it to mid-wicket and gets a single this time.
A length ball, on middle. Rizwan works it to mid-wicket and gets back for a couple. He puts in a dive again to complete the second run. Superb running.
Romario Shepherd comes to bowl now.
A length ball, on off. Rizwan pushes it with soft hands square on the off side and gets a quick single. Good over for Pakistan and despite losing Babar Azam early they are going quite well.
Mohammad Rizwan seems to be in some pain. He has hurt himself while putting in a dive. The physio is out to have a look at him. He seems fine and we are good to resume.

A fuller ball, on middle. Rizwan clips it to deep square leg and gets back for two runs. Rizwan puts in a dive to complete the second run. The fielder in the deep throws it to the keeper's end who whips the bails off.
A length ball, on off. Rizwan defends this off the front foot  towards the off side.
FOUR! This time it is short and same result! A short ball, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan pulls it behind square on the on side for a boundary.
FOUR! Superb timing! A full ball, on middle. Rizwan picks it on full and flicks it wide of mid on for a boundary.
A full ball, on off. Rizwan drives it to mid on and immediately says no to his partner for a run.
A full ball, on off. Rizwan pushes it to mid on and completes a quick single.
Fuller, on middle. Zaman drives it to long on for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Zaman opens the face of his blade and gets it to third man for a couple.
On a length, on off. Pushed off the back foot towards deep point for a single.

FOUR! Wrong line and punished! Back of a length, on leg. Mohammad Rizwan just pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary. All he needed to do there was to use the pace of the ball and guide it and he does that in style.
Back of a length, outside off. Rizwan just steers it through backward point. Brandon King runs across from deep point, stops it with a dive and saves two runs for his team. Two taken.
Dominic Drakes comes into the attack.
FOUR! The first boundary of the innings! A length ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman throws his bat at that one and slashes hard and gets it wide of point for a boundary.
A yorker on off. Zaman digs it out to first slip.
A good-length delivey on off and seaming away. Fakhar Zaman goes hard at it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Zaman pushes this off the front foot towards mid off.
Short and wide outside off. Rizwan cuts this off the back foot towards backward point. Dominic Drakes dives to his left and saves three runs for his team. One run taken.
A full ball, outside off. Rizwan looks to drive but gets the inside half of his blade to mid on.
Who will bowl from the other end? Oshane Thomas it is.
Slightly shorter on off. Defended off the back foot. Good start for West Indies. They have got an early wicket and will look to capitalise on it now.
A fuller ball, on off. Zaman drives it through covers for a couple. Good timing and he is off the mark straightaway.
Fakhar Zaman walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Babar Azam departs for a duck! A nicely tossed up delivery, on off. Babar Azam presses forward to defend but the ball turns away and catches the outside edge of his blade and goes back to Shai Hope behind the stumps. He takes a fine catch and Akeal Hosein sends back the No.1 T20I batter for a duck.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and skidding through the pitch on off. Blocked off the front foot.
Slightly shorter on off. Rizwan gets back and pushes it to long on for a single. He is off the mark.
Flatter ball, on middle. Worked away to short mid-wicket.

The national anthems are done and we are set for the game to begin! The players of West Indies are in a huddle before they spread out on the field. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan walk out to bat for Pakistan. The players take knee to show their support for the Black Lives Matter movement. Akeal Hosein will start with the ball. Here we go...
The players of both the teams have lined up for their respective national anthems. First, it will be the anthem of Pakistan, followed by West Indies' anthem.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, says that the pitch looks good and they would look to put up a good score on the board. Adds that it feels good to be playing at home and they are looking forward to playing in front of the crowds.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that they will bowl first because they want to look at conditions first. Adds that there are plenty of youngsters in the team and hopes that they can start something special from tonight.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Nicholas Pooran (C), Shai Hope (WK), Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Rovman Powell, Odean Smith, Romario Shepherd, Akeal Hosein, Dominic Drakes, Oshane Thomas, Devon Thomas.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Fakhar Zaman, Haider Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Wasim, Shaheen Afridi.
TOSS UPDATE - West Indies have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

West Indies are a depleted side coming into this T20I series as they will be taking the field without some of their T20 stalwarts in Chris Gayle, Dwayne Bravo and Kieron Pollard. The side also had a setback after three players from their 15-man squad returned with Covid positive results and the visitors now have only 12 players to choose from. Their skipper, Nicholas Pooran would be eager to start on a winning note and will look to lead from the front in the absence of some senior players. The likes of Rovman Powell and Darren Bravo have a huge responsibility on their shoulders as they have heaps of experience when it comes to the shortest format of the game. Will the visitors stun Pakistan and draw the first blood in this three-match T20I series? We'll find that shortly. Toss and team news in a while.

Although Pakistan did not manage to bag the silverware in the recently held T20 World Cup, they would be coming into this T20I series high on confidence having beaten Bangladesh 3-0 in their own backyard. Pakistan, led by Babar Azam, are a side which has a nice blend of experience and youth and they are certainly one of the best sides going around in world, especially in the shortest format. We could also see the hosts giving some game time to their youngsters, keeping in mind that the next T20 World Cup is less than a year away.

International cricket returns to Pakistan and the T20I series is set to kick off at the iconic National Stadium in Karachi. On that note, hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 1st T20I between Pakistan and West Indies. Pakistan would be itching to take the field as they would be playing at home after a very long time. West Indies, on the other hand, would be looking to start afresh after a disappointing T20 World Cup in UAE.
...MATCH DAY...
